County Appraiser
The County Appraiser is an appointed position with the responsibility to discover, list, appraise, and maintain records of the data related to all taxable and exempt real and personal property within Coffey County.
County Attorney
The Coffey County Attorney's Office is primarily a criminal prosecution agency representing the citizens of Coffey County and the victims of crime.
County Clerk
The County Clerk is the official secretary of the County and of the Board of County Commissioners.
County Extension
The County Extension "reaches out," extending resources and addressing public needs with university resources through non-formal, non-credit programs.
County Treasurer
The County Treasurer is a public official responsible for collecting taxes and maintaining financial records for a county.
Economic Development
The mission of the Economic Development Department is to enrich the quality of life of citizens by enhancing the economic vitality of the county through the attraction, growth, and retention of business, industry, and talent in Coffey County.
Elections
Find election information such as voter registration, polling locations, and more.
Emergency Management
Find information about emergency preparedness, emergency training, and more.
Fire District Number 1
The district provides fire, rescue, and emergency medical responses to both Coffey County and Southern Osage County.
Fourth Judicial District Court
View the Fourth Judicial District Court website.
GIS & Mapping
The Coffey County GIS and Mapping Department is responsible for the maintenance of all GIS data and departmental support.
Health Department
Access important information for the Coffey County Health Department.
Highway Department
The Coffey County Highway Department is charged with the responsibility to construct, maintain, and operate the county road system and landfill operation as directed by the Coffey County Commission.
Housing Authority
The Housing Authority Board was established for the express purpose of enhancing and improving the housing for the citizens of Coffey County
Information Technology
Browse contact information and responsibilities for the Information Technology Department.
Landfill
The Coffey County Sanitary Landfill (CCSL) is a municipal solid waste (MSW) landfill site which is owned by Coffey County, Kansas.
Noxious Weeds
Noxious weeds left untreated in Coffey County cost farmers hundreds of thousands of dollars each year.
Planning & Zoning
Coffey County is a zoned county and has zoning and subdivision regulations. Zoning is to promote the public health, safety, morals, comfort, and general welfare. Zoning permits and special applications are required.
Recycling
View recycling guidelines for our county.

The Register of Deeds office files and records documents that pertain to real estate.
